Package com.egradx.auth

Class EgradxIamFacade

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.EgradxIamFacade
public class EgradxIamFacade extends Object
What the two IAM controller surfaces both sit on.

EgradxOrganizationController takes an organization id from the URL, because the platform administrator is acting on someone else's organization. EgradxMyOrganizationController resolves it from the caller's token, because an organization administering itself should not have to know, store and pass around its own id. Beyond that one difference they do exactly the same things — so the paging, sorting and id-to-name resolution live here once rather than twice.
